name: NanoPino Security Verification and Threat Model Phase 20

out_of_scope: Pinoox core vulnerabilities not introduced or controlled by this app
target credentials and authenticated session state
third-party extension code after approved installation

trust_boundaries.from: stored content, Builder documents and media metadata

trust_boundaries.to: native Pinoox installer and extension runtime

threats.threat: Unauthenticated or stale session reaches a protected CMS operation.
threats.control: Native Auth context, capability flow and fail-closed anonymous mutation policy.
threats.residual_risk: Authenticated target role/session E2E remains pending.

threats.threat: Cross-site request or stolen/mismatched CSRF token mutates session state.
threats.control: Exact same-origin check plus subject-bound, time-limited CSRF token verified with hash_equals.
threats.verification: RequestIntegrityPolicy, session CSRF tests and route manifest
threats.residual_risk: Proxy origin configuration and authenticated target browser transport require target verification.

threats.threat: User crosses site scope, edits another author’s content or escalates through implicit platform access.
threats.control: Capability authorization, site scope guard, ownership/author-assignment policies and disabled implicit platform_super.
threats.verification: authorization contracts, route capability matrix and PHP suite
threats.residual_risk: Target role switching and anti-lockout E2E remain pending.

threats.threat: Stored HTML, Builder attributes or URLs execute script or unsafe navigation.
threats.control: Strict allowlist rich-text sanitizer, escaped block output, safe URL schemes and CSP.
threats.verification: output security contracts and PHP suite
threats.residual_risk: Fuzzing, browser assistive-technology verification and arbitrary third-party block review remain pending.

threats.threat: Configured remote search causes requests to private, reserved or rebinding addresses.
threats.control: Remote search is opt-in; allowlisted HTTPS hosts are DNS-resolved, public-address checked and pinned with CURLOPT_RESOLVE.
threats.verification: SsrfGuard, guarded transport and PHP contracts
threats.residual_risk: Target DNS, cURL and egress behavior require production verification.

threats.threat: Malicious or substituted PINX package executes during install/update.
threats.control: Canonical path/symlink/resource checks, static-risk preflight, checksum, mandatory signature, one-time digest-bound review ticket and Safe Mode recovery.
threats.verification: PINX preflight on Phase 19 artifact, package contracts and PHP suite
threats.residual_risk: Publisher trust-chain and signed target lifecycle rehearsal remain pending.

threats.threat: Upload content escapes its scope, disguises an executable or exhausts resources.
threats.control: MIME/extension agreement, image decode checks, blocked executable types, size bounds, SHA-256 and native scoped storage.
threats.verification: MediaUploadValidator, storage contracts and PHP suite
threats.residual_risk: Production web-server storage permissions and direct-download policy remain target-bound.

threats.threat: API, archive, query, rich-text, queue or telemetry inputs consume unbounded resources.
threats.control: Native rate limits, bounded query/page sizes, package/resource budgets, rich-text limits, queue leases and capped telemetry.
threats.verification: route manifest, resource budgets, performance budgets and PHP suite
threats.residual_risk: Authenticated concurrency/load measurements and target worker cadence remain pending.

threats.threat: Tokens, credentials, private keys, SQL or internal diagnostics leak through logs or API errors.
threats.control: Central sensitive-data redaction, generic error envelopes, no-store API responses and safe correlation diagnostics.
threats.residual_risk: Target log retention, proxy logs and operational access review remain pending.

threats.threat: Corrupt recovery state or failed restore re-enables unsafe extension code.
threats.control: Fail-closed Safe Mode state, core-only boot planner, quarantine, snapshot integrity and deterministic recovery checkpoints.
threats.verification: Phase 17 fault-injection and recovery PHP contracts
threats.residual_risk: Real target boot order, filesystem and database fault injection remain pending.

threats.threat: Security headers or CSP disappear at a mounted path or are weakened by response normalization.
threats.control: Native response listener, strict headers, HSTS on HTTPS, CSP nonce and structured API denial normalization.
threats.verification: target read-only header scan and source/PHP contracts
threats.residual_risk: Authenticated target Admin and proxy/header behavior across all mounted routes remain pending.

target_read_only.public_site: HTTP 200 with security headers and enforced CSP
target_read_only.manager: HTTP 200 after redirect; no state changed
